summary: Full backend + frontend E2E testing of PolizzaHub. 19/19 backend pytest cases pass covering auth, policies CRUD, scadenziario, dashboard, excel import/export, AI extraction (GPT via EMERGENT_LLM_KEY on generated Italian PDF), PDF template create/fields/generate, and YouSign mock signature flow (create → get PDF → OTP invalid rejected → OTP valid → status firmato). Frontend E2E via Playwright: login with admin credentials succeeds and lands on dashboard, Nuova Polizza dialog creates a policy that appears in list, search filter narrows to 1 row, edit persists updates, delete removes the row and shows 'Polizza eliminata' toast, Scadenziario date filter returns items, AI Extract, Modelli PDF (Templates) and Firme YouSign pages load with all expected data-testids. Auth is required (401 without cookies verified).
critical_code_review_comments: Login lockout uses ip:email identifier; wrong-password test still returned 401 but subsequent runs could 429 for 15 min per IP - acceptable but note for repeated test runs.
server.py serialize() returns doc with 'id' but still contains all other fields including no _id (popped) - correct.
Template PDFs are stored as base64 in Mongo (pdf_b64). Fine for MVP, but large PDFs will bloat documents - consider GridFS later.
In excel import, LABEL_TO_KEY matching is case-insensitive on label OR key - good. However, if a row contains only non-mapped columns it will be silently skipped.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of flows tested (login, policies CRUD, search, scadenziario, ai-extract page, templates page, signatures page, delete)

seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_ prefixed policies/templates/signatures then delete them in TestZCleanup class. UI test creates and deletes UI-TEST-777.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Routes are Italian: /polizze, /estrazione, /scadenziario, /modelli, /firme. Frontend uses cookie auth (httpOnly, secure, samesite=none). AI extraction endpoint /api/extract works with EMERGENT_LLM_KEY on generated Italian PDF (took ~10s). Signature OTP mock accepts 4+ digits. Excel headers use Italian labels ('Numero Polizza', 'Contraente', 'Ramo Polizza' ...) not raw keys - import must respect this.
